Variants.Content: Ny Sar is located in the Norvos Highlands and the upper reaches of the Rhoyne River. Politically, it is within the hinterland under the rule of the city-state of Norvos and its Great Bell. It is a castle mainly responsible for local garrison, tax collection and sheltering the nearby population. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.

Entry Nyarla Local families also relied on mountain roads, bells, timber, river transportation, and farms protected by the city-state; if any road, well, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Nyarla They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the Norvos Highlands; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hooves.

Entry Nyarla If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The traces left by generations of people on Nasa Star are half hidden in the stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs, and the seams left by generations of repairs, and the other half are hidden in the bearded monks, three big bells, and strict religious order. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Nyarla They care about mountain roads, bells, timber, river transportation, and farms protected by the city-state. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain, and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
